li.label: lucky
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a knack for landing on the right side of a coin. At the casino's house games {PAWN_pronoun} plays with a slightly kinder payout plan, and two winning sessions in a row are enough for a lucky streak. While {PAWN_pronoun} lives in the colony, every tenth lottery ticket the colony buys is free.

li.label: unlucky
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} drops toast butter-side down. At the casino's house games the payout plan runs slightly worse for {PAWN_objective}, and every lost session stings.

li.label: gambling-averse
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} refuses to gamble, never gets hooked, and is uneasy in rooms where the house takes bets.

li.label: gambler
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves the table: the spin, the shuffle, the pause before the card turns. Gambling is more fun, and more dangerous, for {PAWN_objective}. As a guest {PAWN_pronoun} brings a bigger bankroll and bets bigger, and at blackjack and poker {PAWN_pronoun} plays a little sharper.

li.label: born host
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers names, refills glasses before they are empty and makes strangers feel expected. Learns hosting faster.

li.label: grump
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} runs the front desk like a customs post. Guests {PAWN_pronoun} chats with come away a little less happy.

li.label: penny-pincher
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} reads every line of every contract, twice. While {PAWN_pronoun} lives in the colony, the bank charges 20 % lower fees. Guests find the prices a little steep when {PAWN_pronoun} serves them.

li.label: silver tongue
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} could talk a river into a different bed. Guests expect a little less after {PAWN_pronoun} welcomes them at the front desk or shows them around, and a guest who joins the colony costs less goodwill when {PAWN_pronoun} is the one who won them over.

li.label: eagle eye
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} notices who wanders where they should not. While {PAWN_pronoun} is on the map, respectable guests stumble on the back room less often.

li.label: steady hands
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s fingers do not shake. As a croupier {PAWN_pronoun} deals noticeably faster.

li.label: caregiver
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sits with the sick and notices who is not eating. Massages {PAWN_pronoun} gives do more good, and children and families {PAWN_pronoun} welcomes or shows around are a little happier.

li.label: peacemaker
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} steps between raised voices and turns them down again. Quarrels in the same room as {PAWN_objective} turn into fistfights less often.

li.label: gossip
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot keep a story to {PAWN_objective}self. When guests leave, what they tell others moves the house's renown further, good or bad.

li.label: kid magnet
li.description: Children follow {PAWN_nameDef} around like ducklings. Children and families {PAWN_pronoun} welcomes or shows around are happier.

li.label: lucky streak
li.description: The dice keep falling my way tonight.

li.label: of course I lost
li.description: Of course I lost. Of course.

li.label: gambling nearby
li.description: People are throwing money away right in front of me.
